item.title: Is ‘Body Positivity’ Just Another Standard For Upper Castes And Able Bodies?
item.description: There is a lack of intersectionality in mainstream body positivity which focuses on beauty standards and not caste-based, ableist oppression. The post Is ‘Body Positivity’ Just Another Standard For Upper Castes And Able Bodies? appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: Why The ‘Female Gaze’ Doesn’t Exist
item.description: The female gaze cannot and does not exist, as it does not embody the systemic dissonance in power. The post Why The ‘Female Gaze’ Doesn’t Exist appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: ‘Kadhal Enbadhu Podhu Udamai’ Means Well — But Misses Caste and Class Realities of Queer Lives
item.description: 'Kadhal Enbadhu Podhu Udamai' is Tamil cinema’s second lesbian feature film, a milestone signalling a long-overdue shift toward better queer representation, rather than reducing queer characters to a laughing stock. The post ‘Kadhal Enbadhu Podhu Udamai’ Means Well — But Misses Caste and Class Realities of Queer Lives appeared first on Feminism in India.
